steps.stdout:
Create the project's outgoing webhook when it has none, or change the one
it has; only the flags passed are sent, so the rest keep their values. The
create is the API's create-or-replace: a row another writer adds between
the read and the POST is replaced rather than refused.

Creating needs --webhook-url - or --webhook-url-file <path>; --active does not apply to a
new integration, which is created active. On an existing integration
--webhook-url cannot be emptied, --secret '' clears the signing secret, and
each event flag merges into the stored toggles. --reminder-lead is how long
before a due date the due-date-reminder event fires, 5m to 720h (the API's
5 minutes to 30 days).

The webhook URL and the secret are credentials: --webhook-url - and --secret - read
them from stdin, --webhook-url-file and --secret-file read them from a file
(- reads stdin there too), one stdin reader per command; the one line
ending a pipe or file adds is not part of the value.

Usage:
  kaneo integration webhook set [flags]

Flags:
      --active                     deliver events; =false pauses delivery
      --allow-archived             write to the resolved project even though it is archived
      --due-date-reminder          a due-date reminder fires
  -h, --help                       help for set
      --reminder-lead duration     how long before a due date the reminder fires, 5m to 720h
      --secret string              the HMAC signing secret; - reads it from stdin, --secret-file reads it from a file; '' clears it
      --secret-file string         read the signing secret from a file; - reads stdin
      --task-assignee-changed      a task is assigned or given a new assignee
      --task-comment-created       a comment is added to a task
      --task-created               a task is created
      --task-deleted               a task is deleted
      --task-description-changed   a task's description changes
      --task-due-date-changed      a task's due date changes
      --task-moved                 a task moves to another project
      --task-priority-changed      a task's priority changes
      --task-status-changed        a task changes status
      --task-title-changed         a task's title changes
      --task-unassigned            a task is unassigned
      --webhook-url string         the endpoint task events are POSTed to; - reads it from stdin, --webhook-url-file reads it from a file
      --webhook-url-file string    read the endpoint from a file; - reads stdin

Global Flags:
      --api-key string     API key; prefer KANEO_API_KEY, since a flag is visible in the process list
      --api-url string     Kaneo base URL (env KANEO_API_URL)
      --human              force human-readable output, even through a pipe
      --jq string          filter JSON output with a jq expression (implies --json)
      --json               force JSON output
  -p, --project string     project id, slug or name (env KANEO_PROJECT)
      --timeout duration   per-request timeout (default 10s)
  -w, --workspace string   workspace id, slug or name (env KANEO_WORKSPACE)
